verdict.rationale: The beta Agent Management API authenticates machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities, so agents can get their own non-user credentials. Per-role and per-group configuration overrides and an Access Control page hint at permission scoping, but nothing shows those credentials can be limited to specific scopes or least-privilege permissions. Missing for 10: documented per-credential scopes or permission limits, a self-service flow for issuing agent API keys, a non-beta (GA) release, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
